avis.titre: Gentle and Effective Scrub That Actually Works
avis.texte: Gentle and Effective Scrub That Actually Works I’ve used a fair number of facial scrubs over the years, and this one from St. Ives has become a steady favorite. The texture is just right—enough grit to feel like it’s really exfoliating, but not so harsh that it irritates my skin. The green tea infusion is a nice touch; it gives a refreshing scent and seems to calm down redness after use. After a couple of weeks, I noticed fewer blackheads on my nose and chin, and my skin feels smoother overall. I also appreciate that it doesn’t leave behind that tight, dry feeling that some scrubs do. The creamy base rinses off cleanly and doesn’t linger, which makes it easy to use in a quick morning shower routine. One thing to keep in mind is that while it’s labeled as gentle, I wouldn’t use it every single day—3–4 times a week feels like the sweet spot. That keeps my skin clear without over-exfoliating. The 6 oz tube is generous for the price, and a little goes a long way. Bottom line: A refreshing, well-balanced scrub that clears pores and smooths skin without being too harsh. It’s an easy addition to a skincare routine if you want something effective yet gentle.

avis.titre: St. Ives Blackhead Clearing Face Scrub, Clears Blackheads & Unclogs Pores, Green Tea & Bamboo
avis.texte: Product Review: St. Ives Blackhead Clearing Face Scrub Rating: ★★★★★If you are dealing with stubborn pores and looking for a deep, refreshing clean, the St. Ives Blackhead Clearing Face Scrub with Green Tea & Bamboo is a powerful addition to your skincare routine. It’s a targeted treatment that feels as invigorating as it is effective. Why This Scrub Works: Targeted Acne Treatment: With 1% Salicylic Acid, this scrub doesn't just wash your face—it actively works to clear blackheads and prevent new ones from forming. It’s a great clinical-strength option available right in your bathroom cabinet. Natural Exfoliants: St. Ives uses 100% natural exfoliants, including walnut shell powder and bamboo. The "moderate" exfoliation level provides a deep scrub that leaves your skin feeling incredibly smooth without being overly aggressive. Soothing Green Tea: The infusion of green tea helps to soothe the skin while you exfoliate. It has a fresh, clean scent that makes your morning wash feel like a mini-spa experience. Unclogs Pores Effectively: You can really feel this working to lift away the dirt and oil that trap blackheads. After a few uses, pores appear smaller, and the overall texture of the skin looks much more refined. Final Verdict: The St. Ives Blackhead Clearing Scrub is a reliable classic for anyone with oily or blemish-prone skin. It delivers a satisfyingly deep clean and clear results at an unbeatable price point. Highly recommended for those who want a glowy, blackhead-free

One thing that I noticed immediately was that the scrubbing agent within the lotion for this variety was smaller in size. I think that I may like this better as it seems to provide a better coverage over my face when working-in the lotion. I am a 59 yr old male, I started using these face scrubs many years initially to help with getting and keeping my face more clean after workouts. I do a lot of long cycling and rucking workouts where I get very sweaty. I like the feeling of using the scrubs after my workouts to get that great clean feeling. In addition, I really like to use the scrubs before shaving as I feel the exfoliation helps to get an easier and better shave.

avis.titre: A Lifesaver for Oily, Blackhead-Prone Skin!
avis.texte: As someone with oily skin that gets shiny within minutes of stepping outside, especially in hot weather, I've struggled with blackheads for years. That's why I'm thrilled to have found this face scrub - I'm now a three-time repeat buyer! This green tea and bamboo-infused scrub is a game-changer for my oily, blackhead-prone skin. It effectively clears existing blackheads and helps prevent new ones from forming. After using it, my skin feels fresh and matte, not greasy. The salicylic acid in the formula is great for controlling oil and treating acne, while the natural exfoliants provide just the right amount of scrubbing action. My pores look visibly clearer and my skin feels smoother after each use. What impresses me most is how it balances being tough on blackheads and excess oil while still being gentle on my skin. The refreshing green tea scent is a bonus, especially on hot days when I'm prone to oiliness. If you have oily skin that's prone to blackheads, especially in warm weather, I highly recommend giving this scrub a try. It's been a staple in my skincare routine, and I can't imagine dealing with my oily skin without it!

I am a licensed esthetician who is quite picky when it comes to facial products. However this is a trusted face scrub which my family and I have used repeatedly for a few years now. It's coarse enough to give your face a great cleasing without hurting your skin. Very pleasant scent of green tea as well. We not only have this scrub in every bathroom but also keep additional ones so that it will not run out on us (for everyday use). Buy it!!!

avis.titre: This works really well, even for sensitive and aging skin!
avis.texte: I have been using this exact scrub for a few years now and I love how it works perfectly for my part sensitive, part mixed complexion. I use it once or twice a day. The bamboo and green tea scent is mild, and the scrub doesn't dry out my face. It's one of the few skincare products that do not aggravate my occasional hormonal acne flares. After I first started using it, an esthetician friend, when I asked for an extraction with my facial was surprised that I didn't have a lot of blackheads — And I think I can attribute that to this product. It doesn't hurt that the product is affordable and that a little goes a long way. You truly do not need more than a pea-sized amount per wash. Naturally, a solid 5 out of 5 stars. :)

I love this scrub!! The only thing is that I don’t use it for my face. I actually use it for my whole body. I use one of those little silicone loofahs. I think this is the best way to use it because the silicone loofah makes a little go a long way. This is definitely a product that I always repurchase. Not only is it cheap. But it leaves my skin feeling nice and clean. It’s not too abrasive. But also not too slippery. I think it’s a great formula. The smell is nice and clean. I will definitely be buying this again.

avis.titre: Good, used to better. Room for improvement.
avis.texte: I’ve used this scrub for years. I like a face scrub to have high, dense grit content. St Ives changed the formula a while ago. The grit did change slightly, it became smaller and slightly rougher (which is GOOD!). The cleansing ingredients however, were better before. I have been fighting blackheads and acne for longerI care to remember. I’ve tried so many scrubs! I’m still using this one, but truth is my favorite doesn’t exist anymore. Neutrogena Blackhead Eliminating Cleanser/Mask was the best product I ever used on my face. NOTHING comes close, NOTHING! It left my face FLAWLESS. The grit was close to how this scrub is, but the cleaning ingredients cleared out my pores better than any other product on the market before or after! Another revision to the cleaning ingredients would be appreciated! Amazon is asking enough in the review features section. They need to add/my answers: Cleansing: 2.5 Stars Over Drying: 5 Stars (does not dry out my skin) Scrubbing Attributes: 5 Stars (for grit size, density, & amount-to-cleaning ingredients ratio)
